dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are Frostmoon Scions here as well?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: That's right. Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's grace should be known to all. I will go without hesitation, spreading her blessings far and wide — be it to the deepest abyss or the highest peak.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Even in a place like Nasha Town, I am sure there are still good people around. Like you, who have surely come to seek Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's guidance... right?
